title: File paths in Godot projects
key_points: Godot uses UNIX-style path separators (forward slash) to make supporting multiple platforms easier.
Instead of using Windows-style path separators, use forward slashes in your own code.
The String class offers a dozen methods for working with strings that represent file paths.
Use res:// to access files relative to the project's root folder.
Use user:// to store persistent data like player save or settings, which can be accessed even when the game is running and the project's filesystem is read-only.
limitations: Documentation on file logging has been moved to a different section
Self-contained mode for exported projects is not supported yet
asserts: Godot uses UNIX-style path separators (forward slash) to make supporting multiple platforms easier when accessing and storing files in Godot projects.
scope: This page explains how file paths work inside Godot projects.
